sentences.japanese: 彼が六歳のときタイプライターの使い方を学び、手で書くことを学ぶ必要などないと先生に言った。
sentences.english: At the age of six he had learned to use the typewriter and told the teacher that he did not need to learn to write by hand.

sentences.japanese: 私はひざを曲げずに両方の手のひらを床に付けることができる。
sentences.english: I can place the palms of my hands on the floor without bending my knees.

sentences.japanese: 君は彼にちょっと手をかしてやりさえすればいい。
sentences.english: You have only to give him a little help.

sentences.japanese: 君は聖書に手をのせて誓うべきだ。
sentences.english: You should swear on the Bible.
